lead: A debug build overflows its 1 MiB task stack decoding JSON far shallower than `maxDepth` allows, and a release build does not.
body: Plain `Core\Json::decode` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/json.rs` crashes the `covws` and `target/debug` binaries on about 800 nested objects, and those are the binaries the proof sweep and `nv try` run, while `target/release/nvs.exe` decodes 1000. Keep a hostile body at 600 levels or fewer unless the attack is the depth itself, and compare against the release binary before reading a debug-only overflow as a shipped bug.
